title: BLITZ funded 25K: C3 robustness (20 seeds, neighbour grid, H1-only selection, size vs give-up line) - promising, not adopted
question: Coordinator round 3: can the funded later-break size + give-up line become an adopt-candidate?
verdict: 20 Monte Carlo seeds, slot $ a month vs v2 (H1 / H2 / 2021-25, seeds better): C3 +16.9 (20/20) / +42.2 (20/20) / +9.8 (20/20); C1 +44.0 (20/20) / +76.3 (20/20) / +4.2 (19/20); (a) the later-break funded size alone +23.4 (20/20) / +35.3 (20/20) / +0.3 (8/20); (b) the give-up line at 1x alone -3.9 (0/20) / +6.8 (20/20) / +6.9 (20/20). Random directions: (b) alone +13 / +2 / +10 = fee saving, not edge. H1-only selection rules (plateau / worst seed / median, written before H2 / 2021-25) all pick room share 0.35, give-up 1.5x, later 2 micros (not C3): 20 seeds +51.8 / +11.7 / +3.2 (20/20 each), but +1 tick 2021-25 -2, 1 bar late H2 -2, 2024 -8, room share 0.5 next door H2 -8.6 (0/5), shuffled labels beat it in H2 (0.95). Not an adopt-candidate.

sizing.x: 2 on a later break, 1 on a first break
